info.description: Local prototype API (simulated issuer, synthetic data only, not production-ready). Every non-GET request must send `Origin` equal to APP_ORIGIN and a JSON body of at most 32 KiB. Generated by `npm run openapi` from the zod schemas in src/lib/shared; do not edit by hand.
